on_schedule.description: Operational schedule is aligned and current.

ready_for_today.description: Daily initialization is complete and usable.

incomplete_timelines.description: Timeline has missing capture windows but the system is not broken.

next_window_pending.description: The next scheduled capture window has not occurred yet.

stale_state.description: Operational state is older than the freshness threshold.

timeline_complete.description: All target capture windows are present for the current day.

degraded.description: Pipeline ran but one or more supporting signals are incomplete.

broken.description: A required stage failed or the operational state is invalid.
